description: Autonomous idea-to-complete-app loop. Give it any seed — one sentence, a vague concept, a complex app idea — and it iterates through brainstorm → think → spec → plan → build phases without stopping until a complete, production-ready deliverable is produced. Trigger on phrases like "loop this", "run the full loop", "take this idea all the way", "build this from scratch", "make a complete app from", or any idea given without further instruction when the user wants autonomous end-to-end execution. Works for any domain: landing pages, SaaS, Three.js apps, dashboards, mobile apps, CLI tools, etc.
